$comment: PUT-TOGETHER stories in TWO COLORS (Year pages Z, 2026-11-14; K.OA.A.2 'put together, total unknown', de 'zusammenfügen', sv 'del-del-helhet'): one thing in two colors, nothing moves (nobody gives, takes or comes), and the question asks for all of them. Read by types/_shared/two-kinds.js. Slots: {n1} {n2} the two amounts, {noun} the thing (its plural; fi: the partitive singular after a numeral), {c1} {c2} the two color words in the form the frame needs (`colors`: one form, or m / f where the word agrees with the noun's gender), {name} a child, {Q} the 'how many' that agrees with the noun (es, pt, it), {il} the pronoun of {name} (fr), {verb} the posture verb of the thing (nl: liggen / staan / zitten, `verbs`). Frames carry a place tag: shelf, box, table, people (what a child has; fi has none: a Finnish name would need the adessive case), garden (only butterflies and flowers, which never sit in a box). `nouns`: a plural this page prints instead of the vocabulary's (a word children use: en presents, nl belletjes, no skåler; de Windrädchen, not the wind turbines). `eq`: the two words of the frame under a story where children do not write + and = yet (fr grande section, nl groep 2, da 0. klasse, fi esiopetus; native and teaching review 2026-11-14); the others write _ + _ = _. `fiForms`: Finnish partitives the story bank's tables do not carry.
